correction: The nsl machines section gave `~/.config/nsl/nsl.conf` as the only configuration path. nsl reads `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nsl/nsl.conf` and falls back to `~/.config/nsl/nsl.conf` only when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset, empty or relative. State the XDG path first and the fallback with its condition; check-site asserts it.
